slices.name: Mockup (approval gate)
slices.description: Static HTML mockup showing all 6 UI states — user approves visual design before any real code is built

slices.name: API module scaffold
slices.description: New AreYouAt module in event-store-api: .csproj, AreYouAtModule.cs with IModule, Shared/IdGenerator.cs, Shared/PassphraseHasher.cs. Register in sln + Host csproj + Program.cs API key bypass

slices.name: AnnouncePresence command
slices.description: POST /api/areyouat/places/{place}/announce — AnnouncePresence command writes PresenceAnnounced event. Stream: presence-{place}-{passphraseHash}. Payload: nickname, date, announcedAt

slices.name: GetPresenceToday query
slices.description: POST /api/areyouat/places/{place}/today — body: {passphrase}. Reads stream, projects to PresenceToday view (nickname, announcedAt), filters by today's date. Returns empty list if none

slices.name: Integration tests
slices.description: tests/AreYouAt.Tests with ApiFixture + WebApplicationFactory + real FileEventStore. Tests: announce writes event, query filters by date, wrong passphrase returns empty, yesterday's presence not returned today

slices.name: Frontend scaffold
slices.description: Root index.html, 404.html SPA fallback, router resolving /{place} URLs. Three-file slice scaffold (slices/friend/presence/). Apply design tokens from mockup

slices.name: Presence slice (UI)
slices.description: slices/friend/presence/ — passphrase entry → query API → render empty/populated state. Includes all 6 mockup states wired to user flow

slices.name: Announce flow (UI)
slices.description: Name prompt on 'men jag är!' click, POST to AnnouncePresence endpoint, re-query presence, show confirmation state

slices.name: API wiring & CORS
slices.description: Config API base URL in frontend (dev vs prod), add /api/areyouat to CORS allowlist in event-store-api Program.cs, verify end-to-end flow locally

slices.name: GitHub repo + FTP secrets
slices.description: gh repo create jawss/areyouat, push main branch. Use setup-ftp skill to push FTP_SERVER/USERNAME/PASSWORD secrets from ~/.secrets/ftp.env

slices.name: FTP deploy workflow
slices.description: .github/workflows/deploy.yml using SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action. Deploys to server-dir: rdp/. Excludes .git, dev/, slices.json, event model JSONs, README. Triggers on push to main
